title: asb sandbox (~/.config/asb/sandboxes/NAME.yaml)
description: A sandbox definition. The same properties are used for `defaults` in config.yaml.

description.description: What the sandbox is for, shown by `asb ls`.

image.description: Image name, from `images` in config.yaml (default: default).

home.description: Host directory mounted as the container's HOME (default: ~/.local/share/asb/homes/NAME).

workspace.description: Host directory mounted at ~/workspace in the container.

workdir.description: Working directory in the container (default: ~/workspace with a workspace, else ~).

protect.description: Paths in the workspace mounted read-only, so the sandbox can't change files the host runs (default: .mpm, .git/config, .git/hooks, */.git/config, */.git/hooks). * matches one path segment.

ports.description: Published ports. A bare port or range keeps its number on the host; use HOST:CONTAINER or IP:HOST:CONTAINER to remap.

network.description: Docker network: bridge, none, or a network name.

env.description: Environment variables set in the container.

readonly.description: Read-only root filesystem (the mounts stay writable).

tmpExec.description: Allow running executables from /tmp (mounted noexec by default).

shell.description: Command run by `asb sh` with no arguments (default: /bin/bash).

runArgs.description: Extra `docker run` arguments, one per item. Use sparingly.

hostPath.description: An absolute path, or one starting with ~/ (your home).

containerPath.description: A container path; ~ and relative paths are in the container home.
